title: Waymo solidifies autonomous lead with massive capital injection
text: Investing.com -- Waymo has secured a landmark $16 billion investment, valuing the Alphabet Inc Class A (NASDAQ:GOOGL) subsidiary at $126 billion post-money. This significant funding round was spearheaded by prominent venture firms including Sequoia Capital, DST Global, and Dragoneer Investment Group.
